name: orbit
description: Orbit dev orchestration — one command to run the full stack locally

scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && npx --yes cross-env@7.0.3 DATABASE_URL=postgresql+asyncpg://orbit:orbit_dev_2024@localhost:5433/orbit alembic upgrade head
scripts.backend: cd backend && npx --yes cross-env@7.0.3 DATABASE_URL=postgresql+asyncpg://orbit:orbit_dev_2024@localhost:5433/orbit REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6380/0 python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.worker: cd backend && npx --yes cross-env@7.0.3 DATABASE_URL=postgresql+asyncpg://orbit:orbit_dev_2024@localhost:5433/orbit REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6380/0 arq app.worker.settings.WorkerSettings
scripts.dev: npx --yes concurrently@9.1.2 -k -n backend,worker,frontend -c blue,magenta,green "npm run backend" "npm run worker" "npm run frontend"
scripts.predev: npm run infra && npm run wait:infra && npm run db:migrate
